plaustrum, plaustrī n.

noun, second declension

a wagon, cart (especially a farm wagon for heavy loads)

The heavy farm wagon, drawn by oxen; Cato and Varro spell it plōstrum.

Other words

  • carrus, carrī m. — a (Gaulish) baggage wagon

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.3 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 403

Examples

  • Periī, plaustrum perculī!

    I’m done for, I’ve upset the cart!Plaut. Ep. 4.2.22 (Lewis & Short)

See also truck, don’t upset the apple cart.
